requested: replace interleaved IDM/Planner training with IDM pretraining followed by permanently frozen-IDM Planner training
preserved: Planner-to-IDM loss path and first-action execution
Oracle identities, source-role semantics, replay quotas, and persistent-async lifecycle
forbidden: updating IDM and Planner in one invocation
resume, warm start, simulator execution, long training, commit, push, or deployment

review.scope: Two-stage plan ownership, lifecycle, persistence, distribution, and proof route.

source_edits.scope: Implement the human-confirmed permanent IDM freeze through local offline closure.

report_write.scope: Write v010 design, plan, contracts, tests, and evidence receipts.

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first, owner-layer, backend isolation, evidence-only, and validate-near-risk rules govern the change.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: One phase owner defines legal source and optimizer authority; trainer, workflow, collector, and checkpoint remain distinct existing owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: A mandatory phase plus pretrained IDM digest is the smallest public fact needed to seal the training lifecycle.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Phase and digest logic stay framework-independent; Hydra and runtime selection remain at the composition root and adapters.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Fresh output admission, phase completion, one optimizer owner, strict IDM-only transfer, permanent freeze, and digest checks close create/seal/load/save states.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan changes only phase selection, optimizer ownership, collector selection, schema persistence, configuration, direct consumers, and focused evidence.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline module and persistence proof are separated from formal runtime, long training, and policy-quality claims.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED/GREEN covers both phases, wrong owner, existing output, digest tamper, exact source/replay distribution, production setup, schema matrix, and affected regression.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Canonical digest includes state key, dtype, shape, and tensor bytes; role spans and planner eligibility remain explicit.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Each invocation owns exactly one optimizer; Planner gradients pass through an eval-mode requires_grad-false IDM whose digest is checked after every update and save.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 4 binds phase, completion, one optimizer, and IDM identity; legacy schemas remain inference-only and v010 resume is rejected.

residual_risks.description: Offline phase and persistence evidence cannot prove learned convergence, walking stability, or live route readiness.
residual_risks.disposition: Require a fresh formal-runtime audit and separate human-authorized IDM/Planner training plus policy-quality audit.
